description: File patterns for the language rule packs. A pack listed here uses these patterns. A pack that is not listed uses the union of the `paths:` lists of its own rule files. The three packs below are narrowed on purpose: their rules name `**/*.ts` or `**/*.tsx`, which would load 11 to 23 KB of unrelated rules for any TypeScript file. Delete an entry to use the patterns of the rules again.
